audit: F7D Intake V6 / ACM Functional & UX Audit — Agent A
head: 43d7a3c5

coverage.steps_walked_live: 1, 2 (all 4 tabs), 3 (up to but not including offer creation)
coverage.not_executed: Creează oferta prețuită / Continuă către ofertă (out of write boundary)
coverage.coverage_basis: All operator-facing controls reachable by this single fixture were exercised live. Controls belonging to artwork/roles not present in this fixture (Vector Logo, cutout text/logo, DXF measured upload, multi-segment panel editor) were documented from component source only, not live-clicked — see field ledger 'Not exercised (code-only)' rows and fixture inventory for untested sibling fixtures that would reach them.

findings.title: ACM panel inclusion status is described 3 contradictory ways across the same workspace state
findings.description: The Step 1 footer warning says the Alucobond/ACM layer is 'standby, nu intră în quote litere volumetrice' (standby, does not enter the letters quote). The Step 1 composition card chip says 'Inclus în propunere' (included in proposal). The payload's product_composition_confirmed marks the ACM item status as 'available_optional' while applied_content only ever lists 'letters'. Meanwhile the Step 2 right rail actively prices and sums 6 ACM line items (86,77 EUR) directly into the visible 2.288,75 RON total. The Step 3 final recap, the last screen before pricing an offer, does not mention the ACM panel at all.
findings.recommendation_note: Analysis/finding only, no fix implemented per audit boundary. Recommend a single canonical inclusion-status source rendered identically wherever the ACM panel is referenced (footer, composition card, recap).
findings.cross_team: Commercial-honesty overlap with Agent B pricing-authority findings — flagged for joint review.

findings.title: Product-composition confirm bundles mandatory and optional components into one undifferentiated click
findings.description: The single 'Confirmă' action on the Compoziție produs card confirms both the mandatory letters component and the optional ACM panel component together. There is no distinct yes/no decision point for 'do you want the optional panel in this offer'.

findings.title: Developer-facing architecture notes render verbatim as operator UI copy
findings.description: Under the ACM tab's 'Avansat' section, a block header reads 'Ownership: MOUNTING → structura_suport + sablon_montaj · …' — raw internal field-ownership documentation shown directly to the operator.

findings.title: Final pre-offer recap omits the ACM panel entirely
findings.description: Step 3's Recapitulare card, the last screen before 'Creează oferta prețuită', only summarizes the letters product (1 strat litere geometry/finish/LED). The ACM panel — already contributing 86,77 EUR to the visible total — is not listed anywhere in this recap.

findings.title: Raw internal diagnostic codes leak into 3 separate operator-facing surfaces
findings.description: canonical_unresolved_warning:* strings (e.g. PROCESS_MAP_DEFAULT_ILLUMINATED_TRUE_TEMPLATE_ONLY, PROCESS_MAP_DEFAULT_SCREW_FINISH_NATURAL, TRIGGER_FIELD_MISMATCH) and a raw pretty-printed JSON dump of the ACM component instance are shown directly to the operator in the shared warnings footer and the ACM 'Detalii tehnice' collapsible respectively.

findings.title: Colț service transformator decision has two entry points on the same tab
findings.description: The transformer/PSU service-corner selection appears both in the ACM tab's 'Avansat' section and again in the 'Alimentare și service' sub-block on the same Panou/carcasă tab, as separate controls for what is functionally one decision.

findings.title: Commercial adjustment controls (Adaos/Discount/TVA/Ajustare manuală) repeated identically on all 4 Configurare tabs
findings.description: The same 4 global commercial-adjustment widgets are rendered as tab-body content on every one of the 4 Step-2 tabs rather than living once in a persistent commercial panel.

findings.title: 'Cadru interior' checkbox shown checked+readonly next to text stating no mounting relation is confirmed
findings.description: The internal-frame checkbox on the ACM tab appears already checked and disabled, immediately next to the caption 'Nicio relație de montaj confirmată' (no mounting relation confirmed) — a field presented as settled and unsettled at the same time.

findings.title: 'Ce producem?' scope mode (Produs complet / Doar față / Doar cant / Față + cant) locks once layer confirmation starts
findings.description: The 4-way product-scope selector becomes disabled mid-flow, so an operator who initially picked the wrong scope has no visible in-workspace path to change it without restarting.

findings.title: Float-noise in an operator-facing geometry field
findings.description: The ACM panel's 'Lățime (mm)' field shows 2000.001 instead of 2000, a sub-millimeter artifact of SVG-to-mm conversion surfaced verbatim in the input.

findings.title: Single-option 'Module produs' combobox is not a real decision
findings.description: The 'Module produs (Volum aluminiu modular)' combobox has exactly one selectable option and is pre-selected; presenting it as an interactive combobox rather than static text implies a choice that doesn't exist.

findings.title: Two SVG fixture filenames reference ACM/ACP but contain no ACM layer
findings.description: litere-cu-fundal-acm-segmentat.svg / litere-cu-fundal-acm-segmentat-litera-peste-imbinare.svg and LITERE-VOLUMETRICE-ACP.svg all reference ACM/ACP in their filenames but contain only CNC engrave/cutout groups or a single undifferentiated layer, with no actual Alucobond/support-panel geometry.

findings.title: Highest-value ACM composition fixture in the repo was not exercised this session
findings.description: frontend/src/lib/svgAnalyzer/fixtures/pbl-complex.svg combines an ACM background with two separate letter groups, a logo, and cutout text in one file — the only fixture that would exercise ACM composition/duplication logic beyond the single-letter-group case this audit covered. Time-boxed out of this session; flagged as the top follow-up fixture.

blockers: Did not execute 'Creează oferta prețuită' — creating a priced Offer object was judged adjacent to the 'no accepted quote/order mutation' boundary; flagged for Lead to explicitly authorize if commercial-total verification requires a real priced offer object rather than the pre-offer estimate already captured.
DXF measured-geometry upload not exercised — same native file-picker limitation as the primary SVG upload; would need the same API-injection technique applied to a second endpoint if required.

Sibling fixtures (doar-panou.svg, doar litere.svg, pbl-complex.svg, annes-store-volumetric.svg) not driven live this session — time-boxed; see agent-a-fixture-inventory.md for prioritized follow-up order.
